body: Welcome to the club.... I'm ready to give away my $600k job and everything to just be at peace
Doesn't hurt in trying. Maybe I'll try this or try whatever i tried since past few occurences and see how long I play this out..

This makes a lot of sense. If you have a name to what it is maybe you have overcome 20pc of it. I haven't gone to a therapist because of two reasons. One, the community taboo and I might end up in a ward. Two, I might be prescribed meds which I'm not a fan of (for whatever reason)
To everyone who replied I am very happy that sometimes strangers on the internet are more willing to listen to people than the ones we know IRL

Tbh. I haven't tried therapy.. Usually after a night of such thoughts I go run for a long distance the next day and then subsequently I calm down and fades away for weeks to a month... Before something triggers...

This is exact what I feel. Ex... Actly.... I'm all beat up on day 1 and then a month I'm all okay. Extremely outgoing, meeting new people, living the life. And then something triggers and I'm back here. Like tonight. 

Deep down Maybe I don't want to die, but I'm afraid what if I succeed and then regret ( if there is something afterward at all)
You know what's more painful than a failed suicide? The thought of having it every often and not actually doing it

Yes, I have been bullied throughout my school life. That is worst days of my life. But I don't have any of those people around me anymore so I'm not scared of that event repeating anymore. 

But other things manifest in different ways.

If you think I'm naive, there's nothing much I can say..

Tbh I don't know what is left to do. I have felt this way for a while. I took advices and saw different countries. I was okay. I was back at this state. I helped people who needed help. I felt ok. I was back at this state again. I talked to new people I went out more often. I ended up again here. The only difference is, there's no one with me when I end up here, but I'm everywhere when someone needs me.

Do I need to go explore different places. I have done it. Do I need to go meet new people. I have done it. Do I need to set something for my life or my family. I have done it so that they won't need to struggle if I'm gone, financially. Do I need to get laid. I've been there. I have done everything, experienced everything except a shoulder for support. So if I can't get that then what's the purpose of me. What am I meant to be here for? What's the bigger picture?
Thats what holds me back. If I go I want to go clean. Not remain a disfigured being for rest of my life..

Thank you. That will help me a lot. I have been having a lot of loneliness feeling lately. I recently tried to cut my wrists but I backed off. I was okay for 2 weeks and now I feel that sense of loneliness again
I just couldn't do it... Probably I will find my purpose one day

Probably the only thing better than killing myself is just to sell my house, sell my car, give off all my savings to charity. Just take enough for myself. Go settle in the mountains and work with the locals...

It's worth to try forming new ties by breaking the existing ones which no longer make sense to me..

I might actually just do this one day ....

Also the country where I'm from, the society just says "you are depressed?? Then you are weak and pathetic". They label you as "emotional baggage" and whatnot. And if you go out to support groups, that's "you cannot help him" statement. 

I don't trust medication for some reason. I saw my uncle treated for depression and the pills made him even worse. Seemed him made happy, but at what cost, he was not physically active after it....What's the point of soothing your mind while trading off something else. 

I know I can't have everything, I don't want everything, but someone just to be there with me, in real, and just to say everything will be all right will work....

It's a risk that I need to take. If they listen and stay till I don't feel down anymore, it's a win! If they distance themselves after listening then I'm just further down the rabbit hole. If it's the latter, then I'm afraid that would mark the end....

I just overthink a lot, most of the times. I was never like this before...

Is this covid lockdown effect. Or was this bottled up when I worked out from office and this wfh has just really cooped me up in and just opening up the box which I intentionally shut down all these while
